summary: Iter 27 — Business Logic Parity: 13/13 backend tests PASS + all frontend UI checks PASS. Verified is_owner in /auth/login + /auth/me (admin=true, staff=false); Bill create split_v2 math for Case A (split with card tip), Case B (card single-mode with cash tip), Case C (split mismatch → 400); Cash Closing summary + POST math (cash_sales net of tip_owed_total; upi_sales = qr+card); Membership 'higher wins' (tenant default 10% vs manual 15%); RBAC — owner-only DELETE, staff bill scoping on list + GET, staff PUT bill blocked. Frontend: 4 payment mode chips (Cash / QR/UPI / Card / Split) render for BOTH admin and staff on New Bill; Split UI reveals Cash + Card inputs only (no QR input); QR/UPI shown as auto-calculated balance; over-limit warning fires. Tests use fresh signup tenants (TEST_Iter27_* + TEST_UI_SUFFIX) — this is proper hermetic test isolation, not demo seeding.
